selection_policy.default: run the smallest blocking validator set that covers every changed surface
selection_policy.escalation: add broader Pester, managed build, or E2E validation only when the changed surface or declared proof ceiling requires it
selection_policy.failure: stop at the first failed proof boundary, repair the owning component, and rerun that validator before broader suites

validators.proof: Registry shape, path existence, fresh-agent wiring, command authority, and report renderer contract.
Required operational harness components exist, are tracked, and are wired into hooks, CI, maps, and reports.
Local harness and run-context contracts remain intact.
Staged Git text blobs use canonical repository byte policy and contain no trailing whitespace.
The destination commit satisfies repository text policy.
No whitespace errors are present in the current patch.
Dependency-free offline survey and harness contracts pass without target contact.
PowerShell parser, fixture, and behavioral contracts pass on a Pester 5 host.
Managed solution restores, builds, and passes unit tests in Release configuration.

validators.command: dotnet publish src/SysAdminSuite.DashboardHost/SysAdminSuite.DashboardHost.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -o tools/publish/SysAdminSuite.DashboardHost
validators.proof: DashboardHost produces the framework-dependent win-x64 publish artifact used by its build contract.
